name: Andrés Ingi Jónsson
detail: Píratar MP 2016-2024; asked the finance minister in writing what a wealth tax on the 2013 model would raise for 2021-2023 (154th session, case 978). A request for a revenue estimate, not a call for the tax.

name: Bjarkey Olsen Gunnarsdóttir
detail: Left-Green MP; on 14 Sept 2017 said she would not argue against introducing an auðlegðarskattur. Not an endorsement; the party itself is recorded.

name: Sindri Stephensen & Víðir Smári Petersen
detail: Law lecturers at HR and HÍ; their September 2021 Vísir article examines the constitutionality of a wealth tax under Hæstiréttur precedents but explicitly takes no position on its policy merits.

name: Ole Anton Bieltvedt
detail: Wrote a prominent op-ed in Vísir on 2024-09-17 attacking wealth taxation ('Stóreignaskattur er siðlaus og tvöföld heimska'). Recorded as explicit opponent.

name: Katrín Ólafsdóttir
detail: Economist at Reykjavík University; analyzed the fiscal arithmetic of election wealth tax proposals in 2021 without advocating for them.
